ABOUT ME

About Me

Technology, robotics and engineering.

I am Hosein Riahi, a 14-year-old technology and robotics enthusiast. I work on designing, building and programming robots, and I enjoy participating in robotics and technology competitions and events. My goal is to learn, design and build new projects and develop my skills in robotics and technology.
